page_title: IPS 1-1 MNU | Ipswich v Manchester Utd 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+4' A corner kick by Manchester Utd is thwarted by the well prepared Arijanet Muric (Ipswich).
90+4' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
90+2' Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' The attendance is 30017.
87' Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the left post is saved by the goalkeeper.
87' Jack Clarke (Ipswich) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
86' Ruben Amorim has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mason Mount (Manchester United) replacing Alejandro Garnacho.

86' Noussair Mazraoui (Manchester United) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Anthony Taylor blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
85' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but Arijanet Muric punches the ball away.
82' It will be a substitution. Conor Chaplin (Ipswich) is ready to enter the pitch as Wes Burns walks off.
81' Here is a change. Liam Delap is going off and Kieran McKenna gives the last tactical orders to Ali Al-Hamadi (Ipswich).
79' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes a shot from a mid-range free kick and the ball flies inches wide of the left post!
78' Anthony Taylor blows the whistle, Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) is penalised for a foul.
77' Fouls committed – 10:9.
77' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
71' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) runs onto a pass and thumps the ball goalward from distance, but the keeper doesn't have to move as it goes well wide of the right post.
70' Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
68' Manchester Utd fail to score from a corner as Arijanet Muric (Ipswich) leaps to collect the ball.
68' Substitution. Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) on for Marcus Rashford.
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Christian Eriksen as he is replaced by Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United).
66' Leif Davis (Ipswich) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
65' Kieran McKenna prepares a substitution. Jens Cajuste is replaced by Jack Taylor (Ipswich).
65' Substitution. Jack Clarke (Ipswich) replaces Sammie Szmodics.
62' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
61' A cross from a corner kick by Manchester Utd is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
61' The statistic for corner kicks – 4:1.
60' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
56' Ruben Amorim decides to make a substitution. Jonny Evans will be replaced by Luke Shaw (Manchester United).
56' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Casemiro departs the field of play to be replaced by Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United).
55' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
54' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
53' The corner is swung in but Ipswich can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

52' Liam Delap (Ipswich) latches on to a precise lofted cross inside the box, controls the ball and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. His dangerous effort is blocked by Andre Onana, who makes a glorious save!
50' A spell of possession for Manchester Utd in an attempt to control the game.
47' He should have scored! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) gathered a short pass deep inside the box but took too long to shoot, allowing the defender to make the block.
46' Referee Anthony Taylor blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Jonny Evans (Manchester United) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
45+2' The game is interrupted now, Jonny Evans (Manchester United) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
43' 1 - 1 Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) collects a good pass and blasts the ball from medium range into the top left corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
42' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes narrowly over the bar. Terrific solo effort, though.
40' Liam Delap (Ipswich) receives a quality pass inside the box and fires a first-time shot. His effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by the goalkeeper.
36' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
36' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 51:49.
34' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) brings his opponent down. Anthony Taylor has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
33' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
32' The resulting set piece from Ipswich is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sends a long ball in, but Arijanet Muric comfortably gathers the ball.
29' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) strikes the ball goalwards from a mid-range free kick, but his effort only goes towards the middle of the goal and presents no problem for the goalkeeper.
28' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul after Jonny Evans (Manchester United) hacks down one of his opponents.
25' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
25' Leif Davis (Ipswich) launches a cross from the corner, but Andre Onana is alert to thwart the effort.
24' An attempted cross from Axel Tuanzebe (Ipswich) is cleared.
22' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) brings an opponent down and Anthony Taylor interrupts the game.
22' Samy Morsy (Ipswich) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
21' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
21' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' Cameron Burgess (Ipswich) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
18' The opposition back off Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the right post. Unlucky!
17' Jens Cajuste (Ipswich) trips an opposition player and Anthony Taylor signals a foul.
14' Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.

11' A big opportunity is wasted by Sammie Szmodics (Ipswich), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the bottom left corner. Unfortunately for him, Andre Onana pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
9' Wes Burns (Ipswich) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
7' Wes Burns (Ipswich) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

7' A short pass finds Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
6' Leif Davis (Ipswich) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
5' Ipswich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcus Rashford (Manchester United) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
1' The Ipswich players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
Ipswich will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
